checks.title: Multi-tenant scene-bundle creation, retrieval, and pagination
Tenant isolation & zero IDOR leakage across tenants
Global curated catalog bundles: visible to all tenants, read-only and immutable against tenant mutation
Fork curated bundle into tenant workspace with lineage link and complete provenance
Optimistic concurrency control: stale base_revision triggers 409 REVISION_CONFLICT
Editable draft revisions: add/update/remove files and parameters before publish
Sealed published revisions: published revisions are strictly immutable (REVISION_SEALED)
Deterministic canonical source & build digests with quota and depth bounds
Parameter schema validation, defaults compilation, and prototype pollution defenses
Tamper-evident provenance record generation and cryptographic digest verification
Download access with path traversal defense and digest verification
Full OpenAPI 3.1 extension: all 10 scene-bundle routes, components, and schemas
Feature still off: custom scene execution is strictly blocked with CAPABILITY_DISABLED

info.title: Creativanta Video Engine — Scene Bundle Registry Extension
info.description: OpenAPI 3.1 specification extension for Scene Bundle Registry, versioned source and build management, parameter schema validation, tamper-evident provenance, and download access (Task P7-02).

get.summary: List scene bundles for authenticated tenant
get.description: Returns a paginated list of scene bundles owned by the tenant, optionally including curated global catalog bundles.

parameters.name: include_global
parameters.description: Whether to include curated global catalog bundles (default: true)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return

post.summary: Create a new scene bundle and initial draft revision
post.description: Creates a new scene bundle entity along with revision 1 in 'draft' state.

get.summary: List all revisions of a scene bundle

post.summary: Create a new revision with optimistic locking (base_revision)
post.description: Creates a new revision in 'draft' status. Caller must supply base_revision matching current latest_revision to avoid concurrent overwrite; returns 409 REVISION_CONFLICT if stale.

get.description: Retrieves metadata, parameter schema, source and build digests, and provenance for a specific revision.

patch.description: Modifies files or parameters of a revision that is still in 'draft' status. Once published/sealed, revisions are immutable and throw 409 REVISION_SEALED.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Download representation format ('manifest' metadata, 'tar' POSIX tarball, or 'files' base64 bundle)

get.summary: Download complete source files or manifest for revision
get.description: Retrieves source files and validates source_sha256 digest integrity.

200.description: Source files bundle in requested format

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: Relative file path within the bundle source tree

get.summary: Download a single source file from the revision
get.description: Returns raw file content with path traversal protection and SHA-256 verification.

get.summary: Download build artifacts and inspect build digest

post.summary: Trigger static security scan and parameter schema validation
Seal and publish revision (making it strictly immutable and ready for render)
Fork an existing bundle (curated global or tenant) into tenant workspace

base_revision.description: Expected current latest_revision of the bundle for optimistic locking concurrency control

path.description: Normalized relative file path (max depth 8, no path traversal)

content.description: UTF-8 file text or base64 data

data.description: File items array or manifest list

Error404.description: Scene Bundle or Revision Not Found

Error409.description: Conflict: Stale base_revision or revision already sealed
